import numpy as np
from collections import deque, defaultdict
N=30
g=np.full((N,N),6,dtype=int)
# 4-colored barriers
for r in range(0,7): g[r,8]=4
for r in range(0,30): g[r,22]=4
for c in range(0,9): g[6,c]=4
for c in range(13,23): g[14,c]=4
for r in range(14,22): g[r,13]=4
for c in range(30): g[21,c]=4
markers={(4,6):7,(5,7):2,(11,19):7,(12,20):2,(13,21):8,(15,14):7,(16,15):9,(18,25):8,(19,24):1,(20,23):5,(22,21):7,(23,20):3,(24,19):8,(28,24):3,(29,23):8}
for pos,v in markers.items():g[pos]=v
# components of cells not 4 via 4-neighbor
lab=np.full((N,N),-1,int); comps=[]
for r in range(N):
 for c in range(N):
  if g[r,c]==4 or lab[r,c]>=0:continue
  ix=len(comps); q=[(r,c)];lab[r,c]=ix; cells=[]
  for p in q:
   cells.append(p)
   for dr,dc in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
    rr,cc=p[0]+dr,p[1]+dc
    if 0<=rr<N and 0<=cc<N and g[rr,cc]!=4 and lab[rr,cc]<0:
     lab[rr,cc]=ix;q.append((rr,cc))
  comps.append(cells)
print('components',len(comps),[(i,len(x), (min(p[0] for p in x), max(p[0] for p in x),min(p[1] for p in x),max(p[1] for p in x))) for i,x in enumerate(comps)])
# compute ring depth Chebyshev nearest complement (includes outside grid)
def depth_at(r,c,component):
 # find nearest complement / out of bounds, Chebyshev dist; depth=dist-1
 best=100
 # outside grid nearest distance to any outside coordinate
 best=min(best,r+1,N-r,c+1,N-c)
 # other in-grid complement. just brute force 900 coords
 for rr in range(N):
  for cc in range(N):
   if lab[rr,cc]!=component:
    d=max(abs(rr-r),abs(cc-c))
    if d<best:best=d
 return best-1
# depths for markers
for i,cells in enumerate(comps):
 mm=[(pos,val,depth_at(*pos,i)) for pos,val in markers.items() if lab[pos]==i]
 print('\ncomponent',i,'bbox',(min(p[0] for p in cells),max(p[0] for p in cells),min(p[1] for p in cells),max(p[1] for p in cells)),'markers',mm)
